worldcombat.skill.flamewheel.summary: Roll forward, damaging enemies along the path and possibly burning them. Thaws the user.
worldcombat.skill.flamewheel.description: The rolling wheel deals about %1$s contact damage; it rolls up to %2$s blocks at %3$s blocks per tick with a %4$s block wheel radius.
Targets after the first take %1$s of the power. Each hit has a %2$s chance to burn for %3$s and knocks the target back %4$s blocks. Hits do not stop the roll.
worldcombat.skill.flamewheel.fierce.on: Blaze Wheel: much higher burn chance and longer burn, more embers, slower and shorter roll - trade the roll for lasting ignition.
worldcombat.skill.flamewheel.fierce.off: Gale Wheel: higher power, roll distance and roll speed and a faster rhythm, but it barely ignites anything - better for rolling through a line.
worldcombat.skill.flamewheel.timing: Range %1$s blocks; windup %2$s s, recover %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costs %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.flamewheel.growth.0: From level %1$s the wheel power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.flamewheel.growth.1: From level %1$s the wheel power rises to %2$s and the burn chance to %3$s%%.
worldcombat.skill.flamewheel.use.0: Roll over a group of foes packed together
worldcombat.skill.flamewheel.use.1: Grind down a target that is already in your face
worldcombat.skill.flamewheel.use.2: Borrow the fire to melt ice off your own body
On: much higher burn chance and longer burn, more embers, slower and shorter roll - trade the roll for lasting ignition. Off (Gale Wheel): higher power, roll distance and roll speed and a faster rhythm, but it barely ignites anything.
It only starts a roll within this distance; it closes in first. The range is short, so a large value rarely matters.
On: targets that are not burning yet come first, spreading the wheel's fire; off: plain melee ordering.
On: the more enemies packed around a target the higher it ranks - the wheel grinds over a line of them; off: it only eyes one target.
